ov: فوكر إن لو (الإنجليزية: Focker-in-Law) هو فلم كوميدي أمريكي قادم، من تأليف وإخراج جون هامبورغ. وهو الجزء الرابع من سلسلة أفلام قابل الوالدين، وتتمة لفلم صغار عائلة فوكرز الصادر عام 2010. ويعود فيه روبرت دي نيرو وبن ستيلر وأوين ويلسون وبليث دانر وتيري بولو لأداء أدوارهم من الأفلام السابقة، فيما تنضم أريانا غراندي إلى طاقم التمثيل. ومن المقرر طرح الفلم في 25 نوفمبر 2026، وتتولى يونيفرسال بيكتشرز توزيعه في الولايات المتحدة وكندا، بينما تتولى باراماونت بيكتشرز توزيعه في باقي دول العالم.
plotEn:
Several years after the previous film, Greg and Pam Focker, along with their daughter Samantha and her boyfriend Eduardo "Dodo" Villalobos, travel from Chicago to Long Island for Pam's father, Jack Byrnes's 80th birthday. During their flight, Greg encounters a young woman who accuses him of trying to pickpocket her, while he was actually trying to avoid the flight attendant after attempting to use the first-class bathroom without permission. Upon arriving, when Greg picks up his now-26-year-old son Henry from the airport, the same woman turns out to be Henry's new girlfriend, Olivia "Liv" Jones.
At the Byrnes' house, Olivia makes a positive impression on the rest of the family with her charming and assertive personality, and Jack quickly warms up to her. Henry announces to his parents and sister that he plans to propose to Olivia. While Pam and Samantha are thrilled, Greg is skeptical about the idea.
As Greg and Olivia spend more time together, Greg becomes even more suspicious of Olivia's intentions, especially when she reveals that she used to work as an FBI hostage negotiator trained to manipulate human emotions. Greg sees this firsthand when Olivia exposes a scammer balloon vendor who tries to sell them an overpriced balloon arch for Jack's birthday party.
